sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

reply.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your message and for considering us for this business. We are very eager to work with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a strong, reliable long-term partner for you. 

Right now, our offer stands at a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. Please keep in mind that without movement from your side we cannot move either. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days. We really want to make this partnership work and look forward to hearing your thoughts so we can take the next steps together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
